title: Beatrix and the Orchard
author: Emrys Delacroix
blurb: Marguerite Thornbury, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
